Cervix, liquid-based cytology

Received is one liquid-based cytology vial, processed as one slide.

The liquid-based preparation is satisfactory for evaluation, with an endocervical/transformation zone component present. HPV testing: positive for other high-risk HPV types. Atypical squamous cells of undetermined significance are present.

CERVIX, liquid-based cytology - ATYPICAL SQUAMOUS CELLS OF UNDETERMINED SIGNIFICANCE (ASC-US)

Reflex high-risk HPV testing or repeat cytology in 6 to 12 months is advised according to the local screening guideline.
